questions.question:
**Sentence of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. These great leaders never escaped from their responsibilities and challenges because they knew greatness would come through great responsibilities. 

B. Leadership is one of the crucial elements in the field of management because most of the tie success or failure depends on the managerial skills of a leader.

C. There are not many leaders in the present world because, unlike ancient times, people are not ready to accept responsibilities.

D. Ancient India produced millions of people with leadership because it is an inner part of Indian culture to create leaders in every sphere of life. Chandragupta Mourya, Gandhi, Buddha, Bose etc. were leaders on this soil.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 4) i.e. "BCDA."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the above mentioned paragraph, there is a chronological sequence of the sentences.
 
• **Statement B** begins with the noun ‘Leadership’ and describes its purpose in relation to failure and success, it will be the first sentence.
 
• **Statement C** is an expletive sentence that begins with ‘There are' and it mentions that nowadays people lack leadership skills because they don't want to take responsibility.
 
• **Statement D** begins with the noun ‘ Ancient India’ and mentions that in Ancient India many people like Chandragupta Mourya, Gandhi, Buddha, and Bose emerged as powerful leaders and led the country.
 
• **Statement A** begins with the noun ‘These great leaders’ and describes that these leaders took responsibility and faced various challenges while changing the course of development of this country and eventually achieving greatness. So, it will be the last sentence.
 
• The correct arrangement is **BCDA.**

 

**The correct passage is**__: **(B)** *Leadership is one of the crucial elements in the field of management because most of the tie success or failure depends on the managerial skills of a leader.*** (C)** *There are not many leaders in the present world because, unlike ancient times, people are not ready to accept responsibilities.* **(D)** *Ancient India produced millions of people with leadership because it is an inner part of Indian culture to create leaders in every sphere of life. Chandragupta Mourya, Gandhi, Buddha, Bose etc. were leaders on this soil.* **(A)** *These great leaders never escaped from their responsibilities and challenges because they knew greatness would come through great responsibilities. *

questions.question: A number is increased by 10% and then the increased number is decreased by 20%. The net increase or decrease is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Use the successive percentage change formula: Net Change % = a + b + (a × b)/100

Here, a = +10% (increase) and b = −20% (decrease).

Net Change = 10 − 20 + (10 × (−20))/100

Net Change = −10 − 2 = −12%

Negative sign indicates a decrease.

**∴ The correct answer is 12% decrease.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given: Initial increase = 10%, Subsequent decrease = 20%.

Formula: Final Value = Initial Value × (100 + r₁)/100 × (100 + r₂)/100

 
 Initial: 100
 

 +10%
 
 Step 1: 110
 

 −20%
 
 Final: 88
 

 Net Change: 100 → 88 = 12% decrease
 
 
 

 
 

⇒ Let the initial number be 100.

⇒ Number after 10% increase = 100 + (10% of 100) = 110.

⇒ Number after 20% decrease = 110 − (20% of 110).

⇒ 20% of 110 = (20 ÷ 100) × 110 = 22.

⇒ Final number = 110 − 22 = 88.

⇒ Net decrease = Initial − Final = 100 − 88 = 12.

⇒ Net decrease percentage = (12 ÷ 100) × 100 = 12%.

**∴ The correct answer is 12% decrease.**

**__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Formula

For two successive changes of x% and y%, the net change is given by [x + y + (xy/100)]%. Use positive for increase and negative for decrease.

Product Stability Ratio

If a value increases by x/y, it must decrease by x/(x+y) to return to the original value.

Successive Discounts

If two discounts d₁% and d₂% are given, the single equivalent discount is [d₁ + d₂ − (d₁ × d₂)/100]%.</p

questions.question: In 1869, who named a new term 'Oecologie' that defined the study of the relationship of organisms with their environment?
questions.solution:

__
 
• In 1869, Ernst Haeckel named a new term 'Oecologie' that defined the study of the relationship of organisms with their environment.
 
• Ecology was originally defined in the mid-19th century when biology was a vastly different discipline than it is today.
 
• The original definition is from **Ernst Haeckel**, who defined ecology as the study of the relationship of organisms with their environment.
 
• The term ecology is believed to have been coined by **Ernst Haeckel** in 1869 though its first authentic use was made by Reiter in 1885.
 
• It is used to describe the “economies” of living forms.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• One of the first ecologists whose writings survive may have been **Aristotle or perhaps his student, Theophrastus**, both of whom had an interest in many species of animals and plants.
 
• Theophrastus described interrelationships between animals and their environment as early as the 4th century BC.
 
• '**Ramdeo Misra**' is known as the father of Ecology in India.

questions.question: Which group of animals has a body wall composed of both circular and longitudinal muscle fibres surrounded by a moist, cellular cuticle that is secreted by an epidermal epithelium?
